headline: Senior Executive @ Ballymore | Complex Deal Management | Client Strategy & Experience
about:
I manage complex, high-value sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and long decision timelines.

As a Senior Sales Consultant at Ballymore, I own every deal end to end for domestic and international clients across landmark London developments, from first conversation and discovery through negotiation to close. Many of my buyers are high-net-worth individuals and investors, often advised by wealth managers, lawyers, consultants and family members, so each deal calls for a tailored approach.

How I work

→ Qualify early and map every stakeholder in the decision
→ Surface risks and objections before they stall a deal
→ Keep momentum with clear, structured follow-through

I also build practical AI and digital tools, from workflows that research and prioritise prospects to interactive floorplans that help buyers picture a home and decide with confidence.

I'm interested in how consultative selling and thoughtful use of technology can strengthen both the client experience and commercial outcomes.

headline: Senior Business Management Leader | Executive Advisory | Business Operations | Organisational Effectiveness
about:
I've spent much of my career working alongside COOs and senior leadership teams to help them run large, complex organisations. During that time, I've led business management functions and taken responsibility for day-to-day operations. I've also been trusted to make decisions on behalf of the COO, giving them more time to focus on their wider strategic and leadership responsibilities. 

That trust has also meant dealing with sensitive and confidential matters, working through difficult organisational challenges and helping leaders make informed decisions. I've drawn on information from business partners and other specialist teams to understand problems, challenge assumptions and develop practical improvements to how organisations operate.

I'm naturally curious and open-minded. I enjoy asking thoughtful questions, exploring different perspectives and considering new ideas, tools and technologies. My love of learning has led me to develop my skills and gain professional qualifications in areas including executive coaching, organisational improvement and agile ways of working.

I've learned that understanding the principles behind different approaches is valuable, but knowing when and how to apply them is just as important. For example, I've adapted agile planning principles to improve how a business management function plans, prioritises and coordinates its work.

Developing people has been an important part of my career. I've recruited, built and led teams, helped colleagues develop new capabilities and supported people in progressing into more senior roles. I enjoy coaching and mentoring, both formally and informally, and creating opportunities for people to grow through new experiences and responsibilities. I believe in giving people the trust, support and space to do their best work, recognising that everyone brings different strengths, experiences and ambitions.

headline: Senior Sales Executive | Sustainaibility, Compliance & Supply Chain Solutions | Fortune 500 & Global Accounts
about:
I specialize in enterprise SaaS and data solutions, with a proven track record of:
- Closing complex six-figure deals with global accounts
- Driving new logo acquisition across EMEA, APAC, and the US
- Building lasting C-level relationships and positioning as a trusted advisor
- Consistently self-generating pipeline and exceeding ambitious revenue targets

Industries I’ve worked with include manufacturing, automotive, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, electronics, construction  — sectors where regulatory complexity meets sustainability challenges.

I help clients adopt AI-enabled and automation-driven features within established compliance platforms — for example, horizon scanning and intelligent search across regulatory content — to speed triage and decision-making.

What sets me apart is my ability to navigate long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles using proven methodologies (MEDDICC, SPIN) while keeping the focus on value creation and customer success.

I thrive in high-growth, international environments and am passionate about advancing solutions that make businesses safer, more compliant, and more sustainable.
